text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Reporter Otonashi and various media 
outlets announced the launch of a new 
tournament: the Twinkle Star Climax!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
According to Director Akikawa, it seems 
a runner must achieve great success in the 
Twinkle Series to enter this tournament.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A prestigious, grand race to decide the 
'strongest'... Maybe it's worth taking on 
the challenge!
